column1: On-Campus Baseball and Softball Venues, above
The proposed on-campus baseball and softball stadiums
will provide the Lumberjacks with a dedicated home
venue designed for competition and student-athlete
development. Both facilities will feature synthetic turf,
concessions, and a sound system along with seating
for 2,285 baseball fans and 1,370 softball fans, which
includes premium viewing areas.
Football Stadium Transformation, left
The proposed football stadium will create a modern
game-day experience for Lumberjack fans while providing
student-athletes with a premier home field. Encompassing
approximately 122,700 square feet of interior and exterior
space, the venue will feature a 10,440-seat bowl, premium
club, suite and loge seating, a synthetic turf field, state-
of-the-art video and sound technology, and direct access
to the adjacent fieldhouse building for team operations.
ADA-accessible amenities, multiple entry plazas and
a nearby parking area with ADA and VIP spaces will
enhance accessibility and the overall fan experience.
